dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there! I'm looking for a new pair of shoes. I'm hoping to find something that's stylish and comfortable, and also a good value for the money. My budget is between $100 and $200. Do you have anything that fits that description?
dialogue.agent:
Here are a few stylish and comfortable options within your budget:

*   **Oboz Women's Bridger Mid B-Dry Waterproof Hiking Boots, Wide Walnut 6.5** - $165, 4.8/5 rating.
*   **Under Armour Men's HOVR Sonic 6 Running Shoe** - $110, 4.7/5 rating.
*   **Cole Haan Women's Oxford** - $100, 4.7/5 rating.
*   **ASICS Men's GT-2000 7 Running Shoes** - $120, 4.7/5 rating.
*   **OLUKAI Kipuka Hulu Men's Leather Slippers, Premium Nubuck Leather Slip On Shoes, Shearling Lining & Gel Insert, Drop-In Heel Design** - $130, 4.7/5 rating.

products.title: Oboz Women's Bridger Mid B-Dry Waterproof Hiking Boots, Wide Walnut 6.5
Under Armour Men's HOVR Sonic 6 Running Shoe
products.description: Built insanely light and supportive so nothing will hold you back the second coach blows that whistle. Paired with soft, springy UA HOVR™ cushioning that pushes you forward—you'll crush those run drills., Engineered mesh upper with seamless forefoot for comfort & breathability. External heel counter for lightweight structure & added lockdown. 3D-molded sockliner cradles the foot for enhanced step-in comfort. Responsive UA HOVR™ cushioning reduces impact, returns energy & helps propel you forward. Combination of carbon rubber & blown rubber in the outsole for strategic durability & lightweight rebound, Updated outsole design has flexibility where you need it & disperses impact efficiently for a smooth ride. Offset: 8mm. Weight: 9.9 oz.. Lace type: Standard tie. NEUTRAL: For runners who need a balance of flexibility & cushioning. .

products.title: Cole Haan Women's Oxford
products.description: To be supplied With nearly 80 years in the business and hundreds of points of distribution in the U.S., Cole Haan is one of America's premier luxury brands. Founded in 1928 as a collaboration between Trafton Cole and Eddie Haan, Cole Haan epitomized artisan quality and impeccable craftsmanship during a time when style was everything. Originally, Cole Haan was a men's footwear label that captured the essence of the 20s spirit with beautifully-designed and well-made shoes for the dapper gentleman. Today, Cole Haan brings that heritage to all of its products, including men's and women's dress and casual footwear, belts, hosiery, handbags, small leather goods, outerwear and sunglasses.

products.title: Dr. Martens Women's Adrian Virginia Leather Slip On Shoe Black
products.description: The Adrian Tassel Loafer first hit the streets in 1980. And with a double tassel and kiltie fringe, the traditional slip-on loafer has been a classic since day one. This season, Dr Martens have stayed true to the original silhouette but updated it in soft, fine-grained Virginia leather. Built to last, it's made using one of the finest methods of construction: the Goodyear Welt which means the upper and sole are sewn together in our heat-sealed z-welt stitch. It sits on our iconic AirWair sole, which is oil and fat resistant, with good abrasion and slip resistance. Seen here in Black Virginia.
